description: Utility functions for distributed training, tensor handling, and metrics in object detection projects, including classes for smoothed value tracking, nested tensor creation, and distributed process management.

classes.name: SmoothedValue
classes.description: Tracks a series of numerical values and provides smoothed statistics such as median, average, global average, max, and current value, with support for synchronization across distributed processes.

classes.name: NestedTensor
classes.description: Encapsulates a tensor and an optional mask, supporting device transfer and decomposition for variable-sized tensor batching.

classes.name: MetricLogger
classes.description: Maintains a collection of SmoothedValue meters, supports updating, string representation, synchronization across processes, and logging during iteration.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the SmoothedValue with a new data point.

methods.name: synchronize_between_processes
methods.description: Synchronizes SmoothedValue metrics across distributed processes.

methods.name: all_gather
methods.description: Gathers arbitrary picklable data from all processes into a list.

methods.name: reduce_dict
methods.description: Reduces a dictionary of tensors across processes, optionally averaging.

methods.name: accuracy
methods.description: Computes top-k accuracy metrics for model outputs.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs tensor interpolation with support for empty batches, compatible with different torchvision versions.
